in_marathi.name: Krodhvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of anger
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krodhvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Krodhvansh refers to the lineage of gods who personify anger or wrath. These deities, including the fierce goddess Kali, are invoked to protect against evil and bring justice.
